title: Template:Player-info
wikitext:
Template intended for use in [[:Category:Players|player]] articles. All fields are optional and are hidden if empty. == Usage == === Example === 
{{Player-info
 | realname = Dan
 | birthyear = 1980
 | birthmonth = 
 | birthday = 
 | aka = Duke
 | born = UK
 | shortbornnationality = UK
 | nationality = English
 | shortnationality = UK
 | currentclan = 
 | clannationality = 
 | adminof = 
 | crewmemberof = 
 | foundquake = 1997
 | retired = 2001
 | color1 = 6
 | color2 = 2
 | favmap = [[DarkZone]]
}}
The code above will appear as follows. {{Player-info | realname = Pavel Galankin | birthyear = 1977 | birthmonth = October | birthday = 03 | aka = darkstorm | born = Russia | shortbornnationality = ru | nationality = Russian | shortnationality = ru | currentclan = Div Sub Zero | clannationality = Russia | adminof = [[RQWL]] | crewmemberof = [[Société Anonyme]] | foundquake = 1996 | retired = 1999 | color1 = 6 | color2 = 2 | favmap = [[DarkZone]] }}
    {{ #if: {{{realname|}}} |
  • '''Real name:''' {{{realname|}}} |}} {{ #if: {{{birthyear|}}} |
  • '''Date of birth:''' {{ #if: {{{birthmonth|}}} | {{{birthmonth|}}} {{ #if: {{{birthday|}}} | {{{birthday|}}}|}}, |}} {{{birthyear|}}} |}} {{ #if: {{{aka|}}} |
  • '''Also known as:''' {{{aka|}}} |}} {{ #if: {{{born|}}} |

  • '''Nationality:''' [[Image:flag_{{{shortnationality|}}}.gif]] [[{{{nationality|}}}]] |}} {{ #if: {{{currentclan|}}} |
